summary: Two Harbors Investment Corp. filed an 8-K on April 28, 2026, disclosing a First Amendment to its existing merger agreement with CrossCountry Intermediate Holdco (CCM). Under the amendment, each Two Harbors common share will receive $11.30 in cash, up from the original $10.80, following an unsolicited competing proposal from UWM Holdings received on April 20. The termination fee payable by Two Harbors to CCM increased from $25.4M to $50M. The board approved the amended terms after evaluating the competing bid. The merger is expected to close pending regulatory and stockholder approvals. Watch for stockholder vote timing and potential topping bids.
